sections.title: How the population has changed in Stroud
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Stroud was the 17th largest local authority in the South West, with a population of almost 130,000. Its population increased by 1.0% compared with 2023, and has increased by 16.3% since 2001.

sections.title: Largest local authorities in the South West, 2001-2024
Population density in Stroud
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Stroud was 273 people per square kilometre, which was more than the South West (247), and less than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Densest local authorities in the South West, 2024
Median age in Stroud
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Stroud was 46 years, which was older than the South West (43 years), and older than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
